neutral_facts.value: The accused, along with another individual, planned to plant an explosive device at the shop of a victim with the intention to kill him. The bomb was placed in a cardboard box and left at the shop. When the box was opened, it exploded, resulting in the death of the victim and injuries to two other employees of the shop. The accused were tried for murder and other related offenses. The prosecution relied on eyewitness accounts, the testimony of an approver who was granted pardon, and forensic evidence to establish the case. The trial court and the High Court found the prosecution's case supported by sufficient evidence, including the testimony of the approver corroborated by other witnesses and forensic findings. The accused were convicted and sentenced to life imprisonment and a fine.

The evidence of the approver PW-2 was corroborated by multiple witnesses and forensic evidence.
